name: Handbook & Craft Opt
description: Improves Handbook search and recipe browsing, and optimizes crafting-grid recipe matching for Vintage Story 1.22.7. Includes a searchable recipe panel, bulk ingredient transfer, and alternate recipe-output selection. The craft catalog and vanilla Handbook search index are kept in memory; persistent disk-cache code is included. Craft-catalog indexing starts at LevelFinalize and processes up to 700 recipes per client tick.
